question_text: Choose the correct preposition: 'She is capable ___ handling the project.'

hint_ladder.title: Hanapin ang Partner
hint_ladder.text: Tulad ng mag-jowa, may mga salitang laging magkasama. Hanapin mo ang forever partner ni 'capable'.

hint_ladder.title: Fixed Pair Rule
hint_ladder.text: Sa English, si 'capable' ay laging may dalang 'of'. Kaya 'capable of' ang laging tandaan—parang 'kaya niyang gawin'.

hint_ladder.title: Pakinggan ang Tunog
hint_ladder.text: Basahin: 'capable to handling'? Parang mali, 'di ba? 'Capable in handling'? Hindi natural. 'Capable of handling' ang swak.

hint_ladder.title: Konting Bulong
hint_ladder.text: Tandaan: 'capable of' lagi! Katulad ng 'good at', 'interested in', 'afraid of'—kabisaduhin ang mga fixed partners.

A.text: You might have chosen 'to' because you thought of 'able to'. But 'capable' is loyal to 'of', not 'to'.

B.text: You might have chosen 'in' because we say 'skilled in'. But 'capable' always takes 'of', not 'in'.

C.text: Correct. 'Capable of' ang forever partner—ito ang tamang fixed expression.

D.text: You might have chosen 'at' because of 'good at'. But 'capable' demands 'of', not 'at'.

next_time_rule: Pag nakita mo 'capable', isipin agad 'of'. Kabisaduhin ang mga fixed partners: interested in, good at, afraid of.
deconstruct_text:
